 Jesse Yomtov USA TODAY Updated Nov. 21, 2026, 2:14 p.m. ET Hear this story Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya was removed in the second half of Saturday's game against Newcastle, grabbing his wrist as he went straight into the tunnel.
 Kepa Arrizabalaga came on to replace Arsenal's starter, who finished runner-up at the Ballon d'Or awards for the world's best goalkeeper. Arsenal was trailing 2-1 when Raya was removed from the game.
 Raya has won the Premier League's Golden Glove award three years in a row as the goalkeeper with the most shutouts. Last season, Arsenal claimed its first Premier League title in 22 years with Raya between the sticks.
 Raya won the World Cup with Spain this summer, but didn't play a single minute as Unai Simon had long been established as the national team's first-choice goalkeeper.
